title: Architecture of the Solar System
bullets: The Sun occupies the center, orbited by revolving planets.
Four inner planets are small, dense, and rocky terrestrial worlds.
Four outer planets are massive, hydrogen-rich gas giants.
Mercury is the smallest, Venus the hottest, and Jupiter the largest.
Natural satellites, such as moons, orbit around their primary planets.
